values.task_boundary: Rebase or replay the local #622 repair packet onto a #648 issue-bound FastWork worktree and publish a corrective PR against current main.
deliverables: Run-scoped provider reload handle wiring for production CSM execution
Overlapping two-workflow and shutdown-order regression tests
Direct global guard ownership regression test
Fresh exact-head review and corrective PR readiness evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Production CSM adl_workflow execution passes an explicit run-scoped ProviderReloadHandle into execution.
AC-2: Sequential, deterministic concurrent, retry, and called-workflow paths propagate the scoped handle before any compatibility global fallback.
AC-3: Dropping an older compatibility global guard cannot clear a newer global registration.
AC-4: Two overlapping workflows with the same provider id and distinct sidecars keep separate provider snapshots.
AC-5: Shutting down one workflow's provider reload owner does not clear or alter the other workflow's active reload handle.
AC-6: Focused production and safety validation lanes pass with nonzero tests and no live provider credentials.
AC-7: Formatting and clippy validation pass locally before review.
AC-8: Fresh exact-head independent review passes for the corrective PR head.
AC-9: Corrective PR is open against current main with issue-closing linkage for #648 and required CI/checks green before merge-ready.
dependencies: #622 closed by PR #646 at stale head; retained as provenance and not semantic completion
Planning #4 owns live Runtime/#640 cutover and live config
non_goals: Live Runtime/#640 cutover, restart, stop, replacement, or config mutation
Credential-backed provider inference or paid provider proof
Provider architecture redesign beyond scoped reload ownership
